We believe jewelry should do more than just sit beautifully on your skin—it should hold energy, intention, and meaning. 

Our Founder is a Certified Energy Healer and Reiki Master on a mission to help raise our collective vibration. Her vision is a more connected and compassionate world for her children and yours. As one of her own rituals, she personally charges each piece with supportive energy before sending it home to you.

Discover our signature collection of egg talismans crafted to bring strength, fertility, and confidence to all Mothers. 

By wearing one, you align with the power of this timeless symbol, inviting the ancient wisdom of creation and the promise of potential into your journey. Let it serve as a reminder of your sacred ability to create, transform, and protect.

Created in homage to The Goddess, our Sacred Pendant was made to deepen your connection to your personal power and bring your awareness to your inherent beauty - inside and out.

Expertly crafted and hand-engraved with a Florentine finish, this double-sided piece features a trio of 8-pointed Venusian stars with diamonds on the front, representing pleasure, bounty and beauty. 

The garden rose on the back represents strength, resilience, and grace under pressure.

The universe offers unending abundance to all who are open to it. Claim yours with this pendant featuring a ripe pomegranate speckled with diamonds, and hand engraved with our signature Florentine finish. 

The Abundance Prayer Pendant calls on your highest Self, serving as a reminder to savor the fruits of your efforts now, and manifest even more goodness into your life. This piece embodies our prayers for collective prosperity and fulfillment.

Our Energy Healing & Custom Jewelry pairings are our most special offerings directly from our Founder, Donnie, a Clairvoyant Shamanic Healer. 

The one-on-one Energy Healing session is part psychic reading, part energy reading, and part reiki. Based on what she sees during the session, she’ll collaborate with you on the crystals and design, and create a specific piece with the energy you need for your healing journey.
Our most reviewed offering for a reason
This is far from being a stereotype of intention but instead, a talisman of personal intention. I love this so much in a way that is without words.

The healing session with Donnie was magical. So much came up that I was able to get more clear on. I also love layering my spell bracelets and can't wait to gift this to my sister for her bridal shower gift.

My session with Donnie was spot on to the themes in my life I had been working with and was EXACTLY what I needed to hear. The crystals in my spell bracelet are beautiful, but more important slur I’m reminded of the key messages and themes from my guides every time I look down at my wrist 🖤

Our birthstone bracelet collection reimagines birthstone magic—a celebration of your essence, encoded in stone. Each delicate layering bracelet features ethically-sourced crystals and a trio of solid gold or sterling silver beads, symbolizing the harmony of your past, present, and future.
Named one of Vogue’s Best Wellness Gifts of the year, our custom offerings are gifts of intention, beauty, and magic—whether for yourself, or for a loved one.

“Treat those in need of a helping hand to an energy-clearing session with Shamanic practitioner and jeweler Donnie Soddu.... Rest assured, even New Age skeptics will relish their new subtle, singular glimmer.”

Cultivate the life you seek with this delicate strand of crystal beads that symbolize the seeds of your intentions. 

Our Seeds bracelets reimagine the classic crystal bracelet—a way to connect your intentions to the healing energy of the gemstones.

Made with responsibly-sourced, untreated natural healing crystals — hand selected for their excellent energetic quality.

Hand-strung on recycled metals for a perfect fit that won’t break.

Elegant and delicate — ethereal on their own, yet easy to layer. 

Energetically cleansed and activated by a Shamanic Crystal Healer.
I love these bracelets! They are delicate, sparkly and well made. Easy to stack and wear for everyday good vibes.

An intention is a seed. You plant it deep in your soul, water it, tend to it, and it grows. ⁠
⁠
Decide what you will plant and cultivate it with our Seeds bracelets. Handmade with sparkling, seed-like healing crystals to embody all your intentions.⁠
The seeds of your intentions are about to take root

Our pieces are more than just jewelry—they’re a testament to the power of intentionality and the subtle art of layering energies. ⁠

Our Sacred Layers are a tool for manifestation, crafted to help you harness the unique vibrations of healing crystals. ⁠
Donnie, our Founder and a Shamanic Healer, charges your Sacred Pendant with the energy you need. If you felt drawn to it, trust that it’s calling you for a reason.

One of the first techniques I fell in love with was the Florentine, a classic Italian style in which a skilled engraver meticulously carves hundreds, sometimes thousands of fine lines into metal, completely transforming its surface. It’s a true labor of love and a beautiful transfer of energy between the maker and the wearer.  Inspired by this artistry, the Florentine finish found on our Sacred Pendant is also hand-engraved, piece by piece, by a skilled craftsman here in America. I hope it lifts your spirits as the light dances across it!

- Donnie
The amulet is gorgeous, it has so much sparkle.... there is definitely something to this lovely little gem.

Not your standard diamond pendant: Ours shines in our vintage-inspired buttercup setting, and the back features an intricately engraved six-petal rosette symbol. Revered across cultures for centuries, this powerful symbol has been used to guard homes and connect people to divine energy, warding off negativity and attracting positivity.

There’s something about the rosette that feels timeless, like it’s reaching across history to connect us to a universal energy—a force rooted in love and the highest good of all. This simple yet intricate design has been cherished for centuries, symbolizing protection, blessings, and balance. It was used to guard homes, bring good fortune, and connect people to the sacred—and that’s exactly why I felt called to weave it into our jewelry.

What I love most about this symbol is how it reflects the interconnectedness of all things. It grounds us in ancient traditions while offering support for the present, reminding us that we’re part of something much greater than ourselves. When you wear the Blessings & Protection Amulet, you’re carrying a piece of that energy with you, a steady source of support and intention as you move through the world.

My hope is that this Amulet serves as both a shield and a guide, anchoring you to the love, light, and possibility that are always available to you.

Wear this pendant to tap into something greater or to conjure up your own earthly form of power. Our lucky talisman charm offers a dose of good luck when you need the support of the universe behind you.

Treat yourself as a Sanctuary. Slowly crafted with love and intention, each adornment serves to attract whatever it is you seek.

There’s something magical about clasping your lucky necklace and letting it fall against your chest before leaving the house. Practices of adornment and rituals of wearing jewelry are time-honored traditions, and the use of ritual jewelry goes back thousands of years. Ancient people have been discovered buried with their sacred jewelry pieces in every culture. In one instance, in a burial mound in southwestern Siberia, archaeologists discovered the glass beads of a necklace believed to be 2,600 years old. Rituals of adornment are not solely for the past, as jewelry can be imbued with spells, worked with in rituals, and called upon for healing in modern life. Perhaps you are already working with jewelry ritually subconsciously, or maybe you are already ritually minded, casting spells with your sacred and favorite pieces.

Call on rituals of adornment to help set intentions. To do this, first, cleanse the piece using sacred smoke, salt, or crystals. Then, hold the jewelry in both your hands. Speak your intention over the jewelry three times. For example, “I call in love in all its forms into my life for the highest good,” or “I call in abundance for myself and my community for the highest good.” Remember your intention when you take the jewelry on or off. Or check in daily with the piece as you wear it, reminding yourself to cultivate this intention in your life.

Talismans are a beautiful portal into ceremony and ritual

Talismans have been around since the Stone Age, and their etymology is from Ancient Greek meaning "completion". They are objects imbued with magical properties intended to guide, empower, and protect their owners. Working with talismans remind us that life itself is a ceremony – personally we love an intentionally selected crystal, a protective pendant, or a luck attracting bracelet.

When working with crystals as talismans, one of the most important things is to bring clear intention to your practice. Crystals are ancient, from the earth, and each stone carries specific healing properties. Listen to the wisdom of the stones and your intuition when connecting with crystals. Allow the crystals to guide you and support your intention.

Our founder, Donnie, started High Light Rituals with a deep respect for and knowledge of energy healing. Over many years and intensive study, she has forged an intimate relationship with crystals and sacred objects. Intending to connect seekers with the right tools, she has curated a collection of crystals and other talismans to support you on your journey.
Rooted in the earth, Rooted in responsibility

Precious metals and gemstones come from the earth, carrying old, old stories. As a mother-led brand we’re in business to treasure these stories, ensuring that future generations can connect with them, and carry them on. 

All of our products are consciously crafted. Our gold is recycled solid gold, our gemstones are ethically sourced from local tradesmen and support local economies, our diamonds are lab grown, and our sacred smoke tools are sourced from First Nations People and sold with their permission. Your rituals are imbued with the highest intentions, and we believe your tools should be sourced that way, too.

Join us in supporting people and planet.   Alongside our trusted partners, we're championing racial & indigenous equity, sustainable farming, and climate resilience. 1% of your purchase will be donated to the cause that's closest to your heart.
Fund a full day outdoor excursion for three Black youth via Black Outside, Inc.
Fund 2 days of wages for 1 housing insecure person to maintain an urban farm in LA via GrowGood.
Fund a doula session with pregnancy education and labor support for 4 Indigenous women via Tewa Women United.
Fund 1 water purification system for the home of a disaster survivor in Houston via West Street Recovery.
The Ritualist, spells, guidance, musings & more

The Ritualist is a place for seekers, for those wishing to bring more ritual into their lives, and for magic makers looking for a place to dig deeper, explore, learn, educate, and create with no judgment. The Ritualist is a journal and a blog, but more than that, it is a home and a sacred space for spells, guidance, musings, and an everyday reminder that magic is everywhere. You just need to look for it.
